summary: @servicetitan/ajax-handlers ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as an AJAX utility for the @servicetitan/uikit scope (repo github.com/servicetitan/uikit, homepage docs.st.dev), but its package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is a heavily obfuscated script (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e`, per-function string-lookup dispatch tables) that at install time downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<name>.zip`, unpacks the `bun` binary, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. math_init.js begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and is an obfuscator.io-style shuffled-string-array VM with no readable behavior. Fetching an alien language runtime and using it to execute an opaque bundled payload at `npm install` time is unrelated to any browser AJAX helper functionality and bypasses Node-based inspection tooling. The scope/purpose mismatch is consistent with impersonation of the ServiceTitan @servicetitan/uikit publisher rather than a legitimate release from that organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
